text.diplomatic: Within thy tabernacle, LORD,
text.normalized: Within thy tabernacle, LORD,
text.reading: Within thy tabernacle, LORD,

text.diplomatic: who shall abide with thee?
text.normalized: Who shall abide with thee?
text.reading: who shall abide with thee?

text.diplomatic: And in thy high and holy hill
text.normalized: And in thy high and holy hill
text.reading: And in thy high and holy hill

text.diplomatic: who shall a dweller be?
text.normalized: Who shall a dweller be?
text.reading: who shall a dweller be?

text.diplomatic: The man that walketh uprightly,
text.normalized: The man that walketh uprightly,
text.reading: The man that walketh uprightly,

text.diplomatic: and worketh righteousness,
text.normalized: And worketh righteousness,
text.reading: and worketh righteousness,

text.diplomatic: And as he thinketh in his heart,
text.normalized: And as he thinketh in his heart,
text.reading: And as he thinketh in his heart,

text.diplomatic: so doth he truth express.
text.normalized: So doth he truth express.
text.reading: so doth he truth express.

text.diplomatic: Who doth not slander with his tongue,
text.normalized: Who doth not slander with his tongue,
text.reading: Who doth not slander with his tongue,

text.diplomatic: nor to his friend doth hurt;
text.normalized: Nor to his friend doth hurt;
text.reading: nor to his friend doth hurt;

text.diplomatic: Nor yet against his neighbour doth
text.normalized: Nor yet against his neighbour doth
text.reading: Nor yet against his neighbour doth

text.diplomatic: take up an ill report.
text.normalized: Take up an ill report.
text.reading: take up an ill report.

text.diplomatic: In whose eyes vile men are despised;
text.normalized: In whose eyes vile men are despised;
text.reading: In whose eyes vile men are despised;

text.diplomatic: but those that GOD do fear
text.normalized: But those that GOD do fear
text.reading: but those that GOD do fear

text.diplomatic: He honoureth; and changeth not,
text.normalized: He honoureth; and changeth not,
text.reading: He honoureth; and changeth not,

text.diplomatic: though to his hurt he swear.
text.normalized: Though to his hurt he swear.
text.reading: though to his hurt he swear.

text.diplomatic: His coin puts not to usury,
text.normalized: His coin puts not to usury,
text.reading: His coin puts not to usury,

text.diplomatic: nor take reward will he
text.normalized: Nor take reward will he
text.reading: nor take reward will he

text.diplomatic: Against the guiltless. Who doth thus
text.normalized: Against the guiltless. Who doth thus
text.reading: Against the guiltless. Who doth thus

text.diplomatic: shall never moved be.
text.normalized: Shall never moved be.
text.reading: shall never moved be.
